# FileSaviour — full reference

> FileSaviour is a free online toolkit of 42 PDF, image, AI writing and text tools. Merge, split, compress and convert files right in your browser.

## How processing works

- **browser**: Runs in your browser. Your file never leaves this device.
- **server**: Processed on our isolated servers over HTTPS and permanently deleted within 1 hour.
- **ai**: Sent to our AI provider for processing. Not used to train models. Deleted within 1 hour.

## PDF Tools

Merge, split, compress, convert, sign, protect and OCR PDF files.

### Merge PDF

URL: https://filesaviour.ahmershah.dev/merge-pdf  
Status: live · Runs: browser · Input: PDF · Output: PDF

Combine several PDFs into a single, ordered document. Drag files to reorder them, preview pages, and download one clean PDF. Merging runs entirely in your browser, so the files are never uploaded.

1. **Upload your file**: Upload files (.pdf) to the Merge PDF workspace, or drop it anywhere on the page.
2. **Adjust the settings**: Choose the options for merge pdf. The preview updates as you go.
3. **Download the result**: Download your PDF file. Runs in your browser. Your file never leaves this device.

### Split PDF

URL: https://filesaviour.ahmershah.dev/split-pdf  
Status: live · Runs: browser · Input: PDF · Output: PDF / ZIP

Break a long PDF into smaller files: by custom ranges, at fixed intervals, or one file per page. The output arrives as individual PDFs or a single ZIP.

1. **Upload your file**: Upload a file (.pdf) to the Split PDF workspace, or drop it anywhere on the page.
2. **Adjust the settings**: Choose the options for split pdf. The preview updates as you go.
3. **Download the result**: Download your PDF / ZIP file. Runs in your browser. Your file never leaves this device.

### PDF Page Extractor

URL: https://filesaviour.ahmershah.dev/extract-pdf-pages  
Status: live · Runs: browser · Input: PDF · Output: PDF

Select pages from a thumbnail grid and save them as a new PDF, without rebuilding the document by hand. Useful for pulling one chapter, form or invoice out of a larger file.

1. **Upload your file**: Upload a file (.pdf) to the PDF Page Extractor workspace, or drop it anywhere on the page.
2. **Adjust the settings**: Choose the options for pdf page extractor. The preview updates as you go.
3. **Download the result**: Download your PDF file. Runs in your browser. Your file never leaves this device.

### Compress PDF

URL: https://filesaviour.ahmershah.dev/compress-pdf  
Status: live · Runs: server · Input: PDF · Output: PDF

Shrink PDFs for email limits, upload portals and storage. Pick a level: light (print quality), balanced, or strong (screen quality). Images are resampled and fonts subset with Ghostscript.

1. **Upload your file**: Upload a file (.pdf) to the Compress PDF workspace, or drop it anywhere on the page.
2. **Adjust the settings**: Choose the options for compress pdf. The preview updates as you go.
3. **Download the result**: Download your PDF file. Processed on our isolated servers over HTTPS and permanently deleted within 1 hour.

## Frequently asked questions

### Privacy & files

**What happens to my files after I upload them?**  
Files processed on our servers are stored in an isolated, encrypted scratch area, processed, and permanently deleted within one hour. Many tools (marked “In browser”) never upload your file at all.

**Which tools run entirely in my browser?**  
Merge, split, extract and crop PDF, image to PDF, sign PDF, add page numbers, PDF editor, every image compress/resize/crop/convert tool including the bulk versions, word counter and text analyzer. Your file never leaves your device with these.

**Do you use my documents to train AI?**  
No. Text sent to AI tools is processed by our AI provider under terms that prohibit training on it, and we delete it from our side within one hour.

**Can FileSaviour staff see my files?**  
No one browses user files. Automated systems process them and delete them. We only look at a specific file if you send it to support and ask us to.

### Accounts & limits

**Do I need an account?**  
No. Every live tool works without signing up. A free account adds a 7-day history of results, higher file-size limits and saved preferences.

**What are the file size limits?**  
Without an account, server tools accept files up to 50 MB. With a free account the limit is 200 MB. Browser tools are limited only by your device's memory.

**Is FileSaviour really free?**  
Yes. The core tools are free. We keep costs down by running as much as possible in your browser.

**How do I delete my account?**  
Go to Dashboard → Settings → Delete account. Your profile, history and any stored results are erased immediately.

### Tools & quality

**Will converting a PDF to Word keep my formatting?**  
Text, headings, tables and images are reconstructed. Very complex layouts, such as magazines or forms with overlapping elements, may need small manual fixes.

**How accurate are the AI detectors?**  
No AI detector is fully reliable. Our AI content and image detectors give a probability and show their signals. Use them as one input, never as proof against a person.

**Which browsers are supported?**  
The latest two versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop and mobile.

**A tool failed. What should I do?**  
Try again once, since most failures are temporary. If it keeps happening, email support@ahmershah.dev with the tool name and file type. Don't attach sensitive files.

## Privacy Policy (updated 2026-10-11)

FileSaviour is built to need as little of your data as possible. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how long we keep it.

### Summary

Browser tools never upload your files. Server and AI tools delete files within 1 hour. We don't sell personal data, and we don't use your files to train AI.

### 1. Who we are

The data controller is Syed Ahmer Shah, operating FileSaviour at https://filesaviour.ahmershah.dev. Contact: support@ahmershah.dev.

### 2. What we collect

Files and text you submit to server or AI tools, processed only to deliver your result.
Account data if you register: email, display name, hashed password, preferences.
Job metadata: tool used, file type, size, duration and success or failure. This is kept without file contents for service statistics.
Technical data: IP address (truncated for analytics), browser type and coarse location, used for security, abuse prevention and rate limiting.

### 3. File processing & retention

In-browser tools: your file is processed on your device and is never sent to us.
Server tools: files go over TLS to an isolated processing service, are stored encrypted at rest, and are permanently deleted within 1 hour, or immediately when you click “Delete now”.
AI tools: text or file contents are sent to our AI provider (Anthropic) for processing under terms that prohibit training on API data. We delete our copy within 1 hour.
Account history keeps result files for up to 7 days if you enable it, and you can delete them at any time.

### 4. Legal bases (GDPR/UK GDPR)

Performance of a contract: processing files you submit and running your account.
Legitimate interests: security, fraud and abuse prevention, and aggregate service analytics.
Consent: optional analytics cookies and marketing email. You can withdraw consent at any time.

### 5. Who we share data with

Infrastructure and hosting providers, the AI provider for AI tools, and an email delivery provider for account emails. All are bound by data processing agreements. We never sell or rent personal data.

### 6. International transfers

Some providers process data outside your country. Where required, transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent safeguards.

### 7. Cookies

Essential cookies: session, CSRF protection and theme preference. Optional: privacy-friendly analytics, only with your consent. See the Cookie Policy for details.

### 8. Your rights

You may access, correct, export or delete your data, object to or restrict processing, and complain to your data protection authority. California residents have equivalent CCPA/CPRA rights. Email support@ahmershah.dev; we reply within 30 days.

### 9. Security

TLS everywhere, encryption at rest, isolated processing containers without internet access, least-privilege access, and automated deletion. No system is perfectly secure, and we will notify you of a breach affecting your data as required by law.

### 10. Children

FileSaviour is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

### 11. Changes

We will post updates here and change the date above. Material changes will be announced in advance.
